title: 건널목 개량촉진법 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Grade Separation When Constructing Railroads, etc. or Improving Routes)
(1) Where a railroad or road is newly constructed or its route is improved across an existing railroad or road, the point at which the railroad and road intersect shall be grade-separated: Provided, That this shall not apply to cases falling below the standards prescribed by Presidential Decree.
(2) Matters necessary for standards for grade separation and for construction of intersecting sections when a railroad or road is newly constructed or its route is improved under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
